report.summary: A botnet attack was detected on Institution_A, originating from IP address 192.168.10.14. The attack has a high confidence level of 0.98.
report.impact: A compromised host that contacts a command-and-control server and may take part in attacks, spam or data theft.
response_steps: Isolate the infected host from the network
Block the command-and-control address at the firewall and DNS
Reimage the host and reset its credentials
